S1_secret_hygiene.reason: Working tree is clean, but git commit 3724e9e3 in history historically embedded a Neon database connection string. Logged as S1-01 in AUDIT_V7.md and OWNER_TODO Item 8.

S2_multi_environment_isolation.reason: Vercel environment variables cannot be audited without active owner Vercel session credentials. Logged in OWNER_TODO.

S3_constant_time_auth_and_serialization.claim: X-ML-Secret-Key verified using hmac.compare_digest; streaming byte limits and decompression-bomb caps; ban on unsafe object serialization.
S3_constant_time_auth_and_serialization.reason: Passing tests confirm hmac.compare_digest timing attack resistance, 413 caps on streaming bodies, Pillow decompression bomb limits, and absence of pickle/eval deserialization.

S4_supply_chain_and_copyleft_isolation.claim: All runtime packages pinned to exact release tags. Zero vulnerabilities via pip-audit and npm audit. Complete AGPL copyleft isolation for production runtime.
S4_supply_chain_and_copyleft_isolation.reason: Exact version pinning and npm audit (0 vulns) verified, but pip-audit detected 8 known CVEs in pypdf==6.16.2. Ultralytics is verified absent from runtime requirements, with AGPL tooling derivative question referred to counsel.

Rule_12_fail_safe_auth_invariant.claim: Unauthenticated or unauthorized calls fail closed with immediate HTTP 401/403 status codes and zero operational telemetry leakage.
Rule_12_fail_safe_auth_invariant.reason: All 60 enumerated application routes reject unauthenticated requests with 401/403/422; tampered and expired session tokens fail closed.
